'''Nuyu''' was a [[Lafrarian]] who worked as a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] artist and a body decorator in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[StarForge Station]],<ref name="Orbit" /> as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> From his shop [[Nuyu's]], the Lafrarian made a decent living selling body alterations, varying from large to small, to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Nuyu used clean equipment and tools.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuyu first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. Nuyu is provided as a sample person who sells goods and services in the market, through which the players pass.<ref name="Orbit" />
